FAKE FRIED 🍗🔥
EP. 01 — NO-OIL CHICKEN 65
346 CAL | 53G PROTEIN | 14G CARBS | 7G FAT
Per serving | Serves 3
The first recipe in FAKE FRIED where we’re taking all the fried food we love and making it without the deep frying.
Starting with one of my favourites: Chicken 65.
Crispy, spicy, juicy and 100% oil-free.
No oil in the marinade. No oil in the air fryer. Nothing.
And the best part? It actually gets CRISPY. 👀

INGREDIENTS
* 500g boneless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
* ¼ cup Greek yogurt
* 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
* ½ tsp haldi
* 1 tbsp Kashmiri red chilli powder
* 1 tsp coriander powder
* ½ tsp jeera powder
* Salt, to taste
* 1 green chilli, finely chopped
* 3 tbsp curry leaves
* 2 tbsp rice flour
* 1 onion, sliced
* Extra curry leaves, for cooking
METHOD
1. Add chicken, Greek yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, haldi, Kashmiri red chilli powder, coriander powder, jeera powder, salt, green chilli and curry leaves to a bowl.
2. Add rice flour and mix until every piece of chicken is evenly coated.
3. Marinate for at least 2–3 hours for the best flavour.
4. Place the marinated chicken in the air fryer in a single layer.
5. Air fry at 180°C for 3 minutes.
6. Flip the chicken and add the sliced onion and extra curry leaves.
7. Air fry for another 3–4 minutes, until cooked through and crispy.
8. Serve hot!
